title: Paris political reports 'mehrteils in Chiffren' to a Princess, numeric cipher passages in French/German letters
correspondents: unknown Paris correspondent (signature on leaf 010 not read with certainty) -> 'Madame', probably the Sayn-Wittgenstein-Berleburg princely house
shelfmark: Landesarchiv NRW / Vereinigte Westfälische Adelsarchive, Fürstlich Sayn-Wittgenstein-Berleburgsches Archiv, Akten A (Altes Archiv), Ber.A - M 20
folio_note: 234 images; leaf 010 ends with a German paragraph that holds a three-digit number cipher (114, 212, 190, 198 ...) above the signature and a date that reads like 1807; leaves 003 and 030 are plain French news reports
status: Archive title: 'Pariser Korrespondenz, mehrteils in Chiffren', 1801-1802. Digitised in full on the LWL server (DFG-Viewer). Viewed leaves 003, 010, 030 (1998 microfilm): plain French reports to 'Madame' with numeric cipher groups in places (leaf 010). No decipherment seen on those leaves.
why: Consulate-period Paris intelligence with a numeric code, a complete digitised file, and probably a key elsewhere in the Berleburg archive; many numeric passages to test a key against.
score_note: Scored 9 Nov 2026 after viewing 3 leaves; the date on leaf 010 reads like 1807, so the writer and date need confirming against the catalogue's 1801-02
verify: Page through all 234 images for cipher passages and look for an enclosed key sheet; identify the writer and the recipient.
prior_art: open as far as checked (9 Nov 2026): known.py on 'Ber.A', 'Berleburg', 'Sayn-Wittgenstein' finds nothing; no web search beyond the catalogue record. Tomokiyo, Lasry, DECODE and the literature not searched.

source: Austria and German state portals sweep (Landesarchiv NRW sufservice API, Saxon State Archives), 9 Nov 2026
title: B. G. Niebuhr, Amsterdam, to Freiherr vom Stein: letter largely in a four-digit numeric code
correspondents: Barthold Georg Niebuhr (Prussian loan negotiator, Amsterdam) -> Karl vom und zum Stein
shelfmark: Landesarchiv NRW / Vereinigte Westfälische Adelsarchive, Nachlass Freiherr vom Stein, Cap.C.I - S 1199,11
folio_note: 14 images; leaf 001 viewed: two lines of German ('Euer Excellenz, konnte ich noch mit letzter Post den richtigen Empfang der von Herrn Bandirector Hundt ... Documente melden') then about 17 lines of numerals from 300 to 3100
status: Archive record: 'egh.; chiffriert', digitised (DFG-Viewer). Viewed leaf 001: number groups after the opening lines, no plaintext between them. Other Stein letters of 1808 in the Nachlass are catalogued 'dechiffriert' (Goltz, Humboldt) or carry plaintext between the lines (Prince Wilhelm of Prussia, Paris, 24 Jan 1808, S 1230,04, also a four-digit code), which gives cribs and a probable key family.
why: Dated, digitised, named writer and recipient in the Prussian reform crisis (Niebuhr's Amsterdam loan; Stein dismissed two weeks later); the interlined S 1230,04 letter in the same kind of code should supply cribs.
score_note: Scored 9 Nov 2026 after viewing leaves 001 and 002 of S 1199,11 and leaf 001 of S 1230,04
verify: Check the Stein edition (Briefe und amtliche Schriften, vol. 10, Briefwechsel 1808, De Gruyter 2015, section 'November 1808') for a printed decipherment before promoting.
prior_art: not settled (9 Nov 2026): known.py finds nothing on 'Niebuhr', 'Cap.C.I' or 1199,11; one web search found no edition text; the modern Stein edition (2015) probably prints the letter and may give the decipherment, not checked. DECODE, Tomokiyo, Lasry not searched.
